Hybridize

Evaluating hybridizing of a single technology power plant

This tutorial focuses on hybridizing existing single-technology power plants with additional technologies to improve performance and reliability. It provides guidance on assessing the potential benefits of hybridization, designing integrated systems, and optimizing the combined operation of different energy sources. This tutorial is useful for users looking to enhance existing PV or wind power plants by integrating hybrid technologies.

Imports

Install hydesign if needed. Import basic libraries. Import HPP model assembly class. Import the examples file path.

Initializing the HPP model

Initialize the HPP model (hpp_model class) with the coordinates and the necessary input files.

[12]:

hpp = hpp_model(
    latitude,
    longitude,
    altitude,
    num_batteries = 10,
    work_dir = './',
    sim_pars_fn = sim_pars_fn,
    input_ts_fn = input_ts_fn,
)

Existing wind

from hydesign.assembly.hpp_assembly_hybridization_wind import hpp_model

[15]:

name = 'Denmark_hybridization_wind_Norhede_Hjortmose'
ex_site = examples_sites.loc[examples_sites.name == name]
longitude = ex_site['longitude'].values[0]
latitude = ex_site['latitude'].values[0]
altitude = ex_site['altitude'].values[0]

sim_pars_fn = examples_filepath+ex_site['sim_pars_fn'].values[0]
input_ts_fn = examples_filepath+ex_site['input_ts_fn'].values[0]

hpp = hpp_model(
latitude,
longitude,
altitude,
num_batteries = 10,
work_dir = './',
sim_pars_fn = sim_pars_fn,
input_ts_fn = input_ts_fn,
)
